LESSON: COHERENCE WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing 3.7 Creative writing (1 Session) By the end of the sub- strand, the lear
Topic 3.9: Coherence Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Coherence Writing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is a choice of the right phrases important in writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify appropriate phrases for coherence writing
2. use appropriate phrases for logical flow in writing
3. appreciate the roles of other language skills in developing writing skills

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Coherence Writing

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Coherence Writing

Teach
• Focus skill: identify appropriate phrases for coherence writing.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Coherence Writing.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Coherence Writing
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is a choice of the right phrases important in writing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
